en.image_alt: A new EDGE video is published on our YouTube channel
en.body:
▶ 💡 Watch our last video on a new tool that gathers the energy data of every Swiss city! It’s called the "recommender tool".  
  
❓ What? The recommender tool is an online tool that centralizes the real-world energy data of your Swiss city.  
⚡ More specifically? It gathers energy data on buildings, electricity, heat, mobility, CO2 emissions, and best potentials of every single Swiss city.  
🙋‍♂️ Who can use it? The recommender tool will be able to be used by your municipality, utilities, or even yourself!  
⏱ When? We will let you know once the tool is available, but first have a look at our video to better understand what the tool is!  
  
[\>> Link to the video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6pumlvLQk6M)

  
With [Philipp Schütz](https://www.linkedin.com/in/philipp-sch%C3%BCtz-a182135/), [Manuel Meyer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/manuel-meyer-169680157/), [Ueli Schilt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ueli-schilt/), [Esther Linder](https://www.linkedin.com/in/esther-linder-732826222/), [Sarah Schneeberger](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarah-schneeberger/) at the [Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hslu-hochschule-luzern/)
